items.t: Chewy Announces Fiscal Third Quarter Financial Results Conference Call
items.sum: PLANTATION, Fla., November 18, 2026--Chewy, Inc. (NYSE: CHWY) ("Chewy"), a trusted destination for pet parents and partners everywhere, announced today that it will report fiscal third quarter 2026 financial results before the market opens on Wednesday, December 9, 2026. Management will host a conference call and webcast to discuss the company's financial results at 8:00 am ET.
